# What a test raises in a window's controls, and what the program sends
# them, as the user's does, in C and Go, on 64- and 32-bit Windows under
# Wine, and in Go calling C directly: a drop-down offered its choices and
# one picked, a check box pressed, a tab chosen, a table's row selected and
# its column header clicked, a tree's node selected and a date picked. What
# each control then shows its fixture's own C reads off it (peek.c), and
# what each handler heard the program records.

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c app.sngl
stdout 'ok +6 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c --opt arch=386 app.sngl
stdout 'ok +6 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +6 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go --opt arch=386 app.sngl
stdout 'ok +6 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go --opt cgo=direct app.sngl
stdout 'ok +6 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import c "sngl:x/c"
import test "sngl:test"
import time "sngl:time"
import win32 "sngl:platform/win32"

output {
    c {
        win32
    }
}

c.link(include="peek.h", sources=["peek.c", "peek.h"])

// What the first control of a class in n's window shows: a drop-down's
// choice selected and how many it has, a tab control's tab selected, the
// check of the check box labeled Run (a date picker holds one of its own), and a date picker's day of the month, 0 for none.
#[c.native("peek_cursel")]
func cursel(n ui.node) int

#[c.native("peek_choices")]
func choices(n ui.node) int

#[c.native("peek_tab")]
func tabShown(n ui.node) int

#[c.native("peek_checked")]
func checked(n ui.node) int

#[c.native("peek_day")]
func dayShown(n ui.node) int

component main ui.node {
    var fruits = ["apple", "banana", "cherry"]
    var fruit = "banana"
    var picks = 0
    var on = false
    var flips = 0
    var idx = 0
    var changed = -1
    var row = -1
    var rowPicks = 0
    var sortedBy = ""
    var node = ""
    var day option[time.date] = null
    var seen = "none"
    ui.vbox {
        ui.select #pick(:value=fruit, @change(v) { picks += 1 }) {
            for var f = fruits {
                ui.choice(label=f, value=f)
            }
        }
        ui.checkbox #box(label="Run", checked=on, @change(v) {
            on = v
            flips += 1
        })
        ui.tabs #tabs(:selected=idx, @change(i) { changed = i }) {
            ui.tab(label="One") {
                ui.text(value="first")
            }
            ui.tab(label="Two") {
                ui.text(value="second")
            }
        }
        ui.table(columns=["Name", "Age"], selectable=true, sortable=true, :selected=row, @select { rowPicks += 1 }, @sort(col) { sortedBy = col }) {
            ui.tableRow(cells=["Ann", "34"])
            ui.tableRow(cells=["Bob", "27"])
        }
        ui.tree(:selected=node, expanded=[0]) {
            ui.treeItem(label="src") {
                ui.treeItem(label="main.sngl")
            }
            ui.treeItem(label="README")
        }
        ui.datepicker(:value=day, @change(v) { seen = v == null ? "no day" : "day" })
        ui.text #status(value="{fruit} {on} {idx} {row} {node}")
    }
}

ui.window(title="Senders") {
    main()
}

func testADropDownIsOfferedAndPicked(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(choices(c.status) == 3)
    t.assert(cursel(c.status) == 1)
    c.pick.change("cherry")
    t.assert(c.fruit == "cherry")
    t.assert(c.picks == 1)
    t.assert(cursel(c.status) == 2)
    c.fruits = ["kiwi", "cherry"]
    t.assert(choices(c.status) == 2)
    t.assert(cursel(c.status) == 1)
    c.fruit = "plum"
    t.assert(cursel(c.status) == -1)
    c.fruits = []
    t.assert(choices(c.status) == 0)
}

func testACheckBoxIsPressed(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.box.change(true)
    t.assert(c.on)
    t.assert(c.flips == 1)
    t.assert(checked(c.status) == 1)
    c.box.change(false)
    t.assert(!c.on)
    t.assert(checked(c.status) == 0)
}

func testATabIsChosen(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.tabs.change(1)
    t.assert(c.idx == 1)
    t.assert(c.changed == 1)
    t.assert(tabShown(c.status) == 1)
}

func testARowIsPickedAndAColumnClicked(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(win32.pickRow(c.status, 1))
    t.assert(c.row == 1)
    t.assert(c.rowPicks == 1)
    t.assert(win32.clickColumn(c.status, 0))
    t.assert(c.sortedBy == "Name")
}

func testANodeIsPicked(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(win32.pickNode(c.status, "main.sngl"))
    t.assert(c.node == "main.sngl")
    t.assert(win32.pickNode(c.status, "README"))
    t.assert(c.node == "README")
    t.assert(!win32.pickNode(c.status, "nowhere"))
    t.assert(c.node == "README")
}

func testADateIsPicked(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(win32.pickDate(c.status, "2024-03-05"))
    var d time.date = "2024-03-05"
    t.assert(c.day == d)
    t.assert(c.seen == "day")
    t.assert(dayShown(c.status) == 5)
    t.assert(win32.pickDate(c.status, ""))
    t.assert(c.day == null)
    t.assert(c.seen == "no day")
    t.assert(dayShown(c.status) == 0)
}
-- peek.h --
#include <windows.h>

int peek_cursel(HWND any);
int peek_choices(HWND any);
int peek_tab(HWND any);
int peek_checked(HWND any);
int peek_day(HWND any);
-- peek.c --
#include "peek.h"

#include <commctrl.h>
#include <string.h>

struct find {
	const WCHAR *cls, *text;
	LONG mask, style;
	HWND found;
};

static BOOL CALLBACK match(HWND w, LPARAM lp) {
	struct find *f = (struct find *)lp;
	WCHAR cls[64];
	GetClassNameW(w, cls, 64);
	WCHAR text[64] = {0};
	if (f->text) {
		GetWindowTextW(w, text, 64);
	}
	if (lstrcmpiW(cls, f->cls) == 0 && (GetWindowLongW(w, GWL_STYLE) & f->mask) == f->style && (!f->text || lstrcmpW(text, f->text) == 0)) {
		f->found = w;
		return FALSE;
	}
	return TRUE;
}

/* first is the first window of class cls whose style's mask bits are
 * style, and whose text is text where it is not NULL, in the toplevel any
 * is in. */
static HWND first(HWND any, const WCHAR *cls, LONG mask, LONG style, const WCHAR *text) {
	struct find f = {cls, text, mask, style, NULL};
	EnumChildWindows(GetAncestor(any, GA_ROOT), match, (LPARAM)&f);
	return f.found;
}

int peek_cursel(HWND any) {
	return (int)SendMessageW(first(any, WC_COMBOBOXW, 0, 0, NULL), CB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
}

int peek_choices(HWND any) {
	return (int)SendMessageW(first(any, WC_COMBOBOXW, 0, 0, NULL), CB_GETCOUNT, 0, 0);
}

int peek_tab(HWND any) {
	return (int)SendMessageW(first(any, WC_TABCONTROLW, 0, 0, NULL), TCM_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
}

int peek_checked(HWND any) {
	return (int)SendMessageW(first(any, WC_BUTTONW, BS_TYPEMASK, BS_AUTOCHECKBOX, L"Run"), BM_GETCHECK, 0, 0);
}

int peek_day(HWND any) {
	SYSTEMTIME st;
	memset(&st, 0, sizeof st);
	if (SendMessageW(first(any, DATETIMEPICK_CLASSW, 0, 0, NULL), DTM_GETSYSTEMTIME, 0, (LPARAM)&st) != GDT_VALID) {
		return 0;
	}
	return st.wDay;
}
